requirements.description: Compustat annual as-reported fields to construct working-capital accruals, candidate cash flows, predictor controls, sample screens and panel identifiers.

required_coverage.population: Compustat as-reported firm-year panel of 209,530 observations used in the 1950–2009 tests.
required_coverage.detail: Known table-note raw requirements extend to t−2 for CF(t−1) and t+1 for CF(t+1); raw bounds are by the paper’s reported annual observation years.

routes.mapping_notes: The source gives Compustat mnemonics and equations for each raw field. The current local columns verify field presence, but the source’s original as-reported vintage and full historical population are not confirmed.
routes.coverage_notes: Raw range is extended for t−1 differences/scaling, CF leads/lags and the stated 1950–2009 panel; local coverage remains unconfirmed.

requirements.unresolved_reason: No coordinator coverage confirmation establishes the 1948–2010 raw envelope or the 1950–2009 sample population in the current local Compustat snapshot.

requirements.description: Operational definition of CF for the Dechow–Dichev and McNichols fits.

required_coverage.population: Cash-flow observations at t−1, t and t+1 for the DD and McNichols fits.
required_coverage.detail: The paper conflicts between CF=ib−DAP and the Table 2 note CF=ib−WC_ACC; it does not operationalize DAP for the dataset.

requirements.unresolved_reason: The source provides two incompatible/unequated operational constructions, and the DAP alternative has no bounded raw construction window.

variable_coverage.construction: Noncash working-capital accruals: change in current assets minus the change in current liabilities and cash, plus the change in short-term debt, scaled by prior-year total assets. The table note identifies Compustat act, lct, che, dlc, and at, respectively. Formula: (ΔCA_{i,t} − ΔCL_{i,t} − ΔCash_{i,t} + ΔSTD_{i,t}) / A_{i,t−1}. Raw inputs use req_comp_panel.

Indicator equal to 1 for the 100 randomly selected firm-years designated as earnings-management years in a draw, and 0 otherwise. Formula: 1 for a selected earnings-management firm-year; 0 otherwise.. This is generated by the repeated random-draw design from the firm-year panel, not a supplied observed field. Raw inputs use req_comp_panel.

Indicator equal to 1 in the first year following the randomly selected earnings-management years when data are available, and 0 otherwise. Formula: 1 in the first year following the selected earnings-management year when available; 0 otherwise.. This is generated by the repeated random-draw design from the firm-year panel, not a supplied observed field. Raw inputs use req_comp_panel.

Indicator equal to 1 in the second year following the randomly selected earnings-management years when data are available, and 0 otherwise. Formula: 1 in the second year following the selected earnings-management year when available; 0 otherwise.. This is generated by the repeated random-draw design from the firm-year panel, not a supplied observed field. Raw inputs use req_comp_panel.

design_coverage.reason: The paper samples firm-years from the 1950–2009 Compustat panel; simulation draws 100 firm-years with the stated seed and repeats 1,000 times.
GVKEY is needed to retain firm-year panel identity and any firm-specific serial-correlation design.
The source explicitly describes a pooled single panel; it does not identify fixed-effect dimensions for this baseline.
No clustering dimensions are reported; HC3 is the stated heteroskedasticity covariance correction.
No observation weights are reported for the fitted baseline equations.
The source says pooled regressions but does not identify the fitted-coefficient estimator; HC3 describes covariance, not estimator.
The source requires DATAFMT=STD as-reported/unrestated values, excludes financial firms and winsorizes financial variables at 1% tails.

implementation_issues.description: The paper describes pooled regressions but does not identify the estimator used for the fitted coefficients; HC3 is only the covariance correction.
The study explicitly uses original as-reported/unrestated DATAFMT=STD Compustat data; the present local snapshot is not confirmed to match the study-era vintage or its sample population.

Cash-flow proxy at t−1. Section 3.2.4 defines CF as earnings before extraordinary items minus DAP; Section 2.1 defines DAP generically as (DA−μ)+η, without a dataset-specific operational construction. The Table 2 note instead defines CF as Compustat ib minus WC_ACC. WC_ACC is asset-scaled, but the Table 2 note does not state the scaling of ib or reconcile the definitions. Formula: EBEI_{i,t−1} − DAP_{i,t−1} (Section 3.2.4); alternatively ib_{i,t−1} − WC_ACC_{i,t−1} (Table 2 note).. The table-note route uses ib−WC_ACC; the Section 3.2.4 definition uses ib−DAP and remains unresolved. Raw inputs use req_comp_panel, req_cf_definition.
